title: The Beauty and the Bias: Attractiveness, Empathy, and Forensic Decision-Making
summary:
This study investigates how people evaluate others. We examine whether a person’s appearance influences how much empathy is felt and how strictly they are judged.
Participants view faces and short case descriptions and provide their evaluations.
conditions: No disease is investigated. The study focuses on social decision-making processes.

interventions.name:
One-time participation in an online study consisting of:
(1) demographic questions
(2) empathy questionnaire
(3) evaluation of faces regarding empathy
(4) reading case vignettes and providing sentencing decisions

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Eligible participants are adults (≥ 18 years) with sufficient German language skills to complete the online study and access to an internet-enabled device.
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals under 18 years of age and those without sufficient German language skills are excluded. In addition, incomplete datasets will be excluded from analysis.
